Web check of 2026-07-27. No establishment retained. Andorra has a single higher education institution, the University of Andorra, whose provision covers nursing, computing, business administration and education, with no drama faculty or higher arts school. In the absence of any higher arts education in the country, no specialised higher training in puppetry arts can exist. Upper bound held at 0 for that reason, rather than raised to 1 as in countries that do have theatre education where a candidate could have escaped the search. Estimate: the argument rests on the size of the higher education system, not on a source read.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
